requirements.title: IBITS argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I shall be integer; POS shall be an integer nonnegative value with POS+LEN not greater than BIT_SIZE(I); LEN shall be an integer nonnegative value.

pending.IBITS-I-integer: Use an integer I with selected source bits; mutate I to real as a source-control restriction with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IBITS-POS-integer-nonnegative: Use integer POS values 0 and 2; mutate POS to real or negative as source-control restrictions with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IBITS-LEN-integer-nonnegative: Use integer LEN values 0 and 3; mutate LEN to real or negative as source-control restrictions with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IBITS-POS-plus-LEN-in-range: Use POS=BIT_SIZE(I)-2 with LEN=2 and POS=BIT_SIZE(I)-1 with LEN=1 as the upper valid boundaries. For z=BIT_SIZE(I), assert IBITS(IBSET(0,z-1),z-1,1) is numerically 1 and IBITS(0,z-1,1) is 0; LEN=1 makes the result exactly 0 or 1. Mutate POS to z as a source-control restriction with no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: IBITS result characteristics match I
requirements.definition: The IBITS result has the same characteristics as I.

pending.IBITS-result-same-kind-as-I: Use I with a nondefault integer kind; assert KIND(IBITS(I,1,3)) equals KIND(I) and verify the value by BTEST separately.

requirements.title: IBITS extracts and right-adjusts LEN bits
requirements.definition: The IBITS result contains the LEN bits of I beginning at POS right-adjusted, with every other bit zero, using the integer bit model of 16.3.

pending.IBITS-extracted-bits-right-adjusted: Use I with source bits POS and POS+2 set and POS+1 clear; call IBITS(I,POS,3) and assert result bits 0 and 2 true and bit 1 false by BTEST. Also exercise the high-bit edge with z=BIT_SIZE(I): IBITS(IBSET(0,z-1),z-1,1) equals 1 and IBITS(0,z-1,1) equals 0, whose LEN=1 results are numerically safe.
pending.IBITS-other-result-bits-zero: For the same call assert POPCNT(IBITS(I,POS,3)) equals two, proving no outside bit remains set; mutate POS by one to change the pattern.
pending.IBITS-zero-len-result-zero: Use LEN=0 and assert POPCNT(result) equals zero, paired with a LEN=3 companion whose result has nonzero POPCNT.
